summary: You take ECON 1, ECON 102A, ECON 102B, PUBLPOL 104, PUBLPOL 50 or ECON 50, and one or more electives from the list, at least six courses of five units each and 30 units in all. At most 10 units may be CR/NC, and at most 5 of them in ECON 102A and 102B. Reviewing your course plan with a program administrator is checked by hand, and so are courses you substitute because your major already uses a requirement (an Economics major replaces PUBLPOL 50 with another course).
